entity_raw.definition_raw: Undead SubdomainSource Advanced Player's Guide pg. 1Associated Domain(s): DeathAssociated Deities: Aesdurath, Arlachramas, Baalzebul, Barravoclair, Chamiaholom, Charon, Chugarra, Circiatto, Deumus, Fumeiyoshi, Gogunta, Ioramvol, Kabriri, Kalma, Lorcan, Mahathallah, Menxyr, Mneoc, Mordiggian, Nhimbaloth, Orcus, Ruzel, Set, Sithhud, Urgathoa, Uzumae, Venkelvore, Xhamen-Dor, Xsistaid, Yaezhing, Zagresh, Zon-Kuthon, Zura, ZyphusReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the bleeding touch power of the Death domain. Death’s Kiss (Su): You can cause a creature to take on some of the traits of the undead with a melee touch attack. Touched creatures are treated as undead for the purposes of effects that heal or cause damage based on positive and negative energy. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1). It does not apply to the Turn Undead or Command Undead feats. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—ghoul touch, 4th—enervation, 9th—energy drain.
